question: If January 1, 2024 fell on a Monday, on which day of the week did January 1, 2025 fall?
explanation: The year 2024 is a leap year (divisible by 4) and contains 366 days. Number of odd days in a leap year = 366 mod 7 = 2 odd days. Moving 1 full year ahead from Jan 1, 2024 to Jan 1, 2025 adds 2 days to Monday: Monday + 2 days = Wednesday.

question: In a group of 50 students, 30 play Football and 25 play Cricket. If 10 students play neither sport, how many students play both Football and Cricket?
explanation: Total students playing at least one sport = Total - Neither = 50 - 10 = 40. By Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion: n(F ∪ C) = n(F) + n(C) - n(F ∩ C) => 40 = 30 + 25 - n(F ∩ C) => 40 = 55 - n(F ∩ C) => n(F ∩ C) = 55 - 40 = 15.
